source_scope: Original public project specification of local design/fictional lab identifiers; not an independent source for any manufacturer requirement and not a clean-room or native-compatibility attestation.

decisions.description: A locally selected unsupported-operation refusal code in the project's JSON control replies. It is not an HTTP response status here and is not claimed to have a manufacturer-defined meaning.

A locally selected fail-closed refusal code for invalid/unavailable control operations. The project does not claim that this number is the manufacturer's required error code, or that all controller versions interpret it identically.

The retained status profile string ubntbox-0.1.7-v1-info is a legacy project diagnostic identifier. Retaining its spelling avoids silently changing existing status consumers; it does not claim vendor implementation parity, vendor origin or independent observation of a binary.
An explicitly synthetic lab task path. The fixture suffix is invented by this project and is not a real controller task ID or an assertion of native endpoint acceptance.
An explicitly synthetic lab image path. The fixture suffix is invented; this lab example neither carries camera media nor demonstrates native image-route acceptance.
